    KEY $._station_id

    KEY $._norad
  APPEND_ITEM FRAME_BYTES 32 UINT "Frame length (bytes)"
    KEY $._frame_bytes
  APPEND_ITEM FRAME_HEX 4096 STRING "The raw frame, hex"
    KEY $._frame_hex
